name: Oriel
note: Every design value of Oriel, the one source. Drawn in the Oriel design system Design artifact; generated into Go by internal/ui/theme/tokens (go generate there). Explained in tokens.md.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The window, the toolbar bar and the timeline: warm paper in light, graphite with a hint of teal in dark. Never pure white or black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Things that sit on a region: code blocks, notes, plain cards, fields, picture placeholders. No rim and no shadow in the flow.

tokens.name: float
tokens.usage: Things that float over content: dialogs, the command palette, the key sheet, select menus, the font picker, a focused search. Opaque, with line2 and a sheet shadow.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: The resting face of a control: the segmented trough, the search field, inline code, a monogram tile, a skeleton bar. Step 1 of the state ladder.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hovered row or control. Step 2. / dark rgba(234,240,238,.06).)

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: The chosen row, navigation item or menu item. Step 3: darker than hover, so a hovered chosen row still reads as chosen. Neutral, never tinted with the accent. / dark rgba(234,240,238,.085).)

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed. Step 4, the deepest, so pressing a chosen row still shows. / dark rgba(234,240,238,.11).)

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: The chosen segment of a segmented control or capsule, lighter than its fill trough, with shadow-raised.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Titles and primary text. Target 10:1 on every text bed.

tokens.name: prose
tokens.usage: The reading body, a step softer than fg for long reading. Target 8.5:1.

tokens.name: fg2
tokens.usage: Source names, summaries, the unselected labels of a segmented control, unselected names. Target 7:1.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Meta, times, counts, read titles, hints, placeholders. Target 4.5:1 on every bed, the fill and the selected row included, so no screen needs an exception.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Disabled glyphs only, never the only copy of a label. Target 2.6:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Oriel's one color, a muted teal that does not follow the system accent: the unread dot, links, the primary button, a chosen icon, the selection marker, the AI card's head. Target 4.5:1 (it is link text).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered primary button.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed primary button.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent. 4.5:1 on accent.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: A starred entry: the only hue besides the accent and status. A graphic, never text. Target 3:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failure and destructive actions; may be text. Always with words or a symbol. Target 4.5:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: The server dot and positive results; may be text. Target 4.5:1.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution; a graphic, never text. Target 3:1.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Accent at the soft alpha; other meanings take the same alpha of their own color. The alpha of a meaning color behind an icon or a status: the AI card, a note, a health line, an on toolbar button. soft(accent), soft(danger).

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring, 2 DIPs, always visible. 3:1 as a control boundary.

tokens.name: link-underline
tokens.usage: A link's underline at rest; accent on hover.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltips and toasts: a charcoal tile.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Ivory text on inverse.

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: The duration and picture-count badge on a cover, with white caption text.

tokens.name: viewer
tokens.usage: The image viewer's opaque ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and dividers inside cards. Never around a card or a control.

tokens.name: line2
tokens.usage: Rims: floats, raised segments, form edges, the 0.5 DIP outline of an image.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: A quote's line in prose.

tokens.name: scrollbar
tokens.usage: Scroll bar thumbs, 6 DIPs wide.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The color of shadow-popup and shadow-raised.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: The color of shadow-dialog.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dim behind a dialog.

tokens.name: pane

tokens.name: pane-hover

tokens.name: pane-fg

tokens.name: logo-body
tokens.usage: The mark's frame and arcs. It keeps the brand ink, within a step of fg; never used in the interface.

tokens.name: logo-tile

type.note: zh holds what Simplified Chinese changes: it runs taller and carries no tracking. The Reading group is at Medium, Standard; the reading choices scale it.

native.note: The families the app asks the platform for. Sans is the platform UI font, or the Interface font chosen in Settings; serif is the first installed of its list.

reading.note: The reader's choices, by the names Settings stores: text size scales the Reading group, line spacing replaces its body line height, line width scales column. Spaces are in em of the body size.

spacing.note: Multiples of Theme.Spacing (4 at default; 3 compact, 5 roomy), so density scales them. Values at default.

radius.note: By role. Scale with the text size like every size. A pill or circle is half its height.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Rows in a popup, select options, segments, row actions, strip pictures.

tokens.name: radius-control

tokens.name: radius-pill

shadow.note: Only floating things cast a shadow; everything in the flow is flat.

opacity.note: Opacity is taken only from here, never written in a view. A disabled control does not fade: its glyph takes faint and its label stays muted. A meaning color behind an icon takes soft, not an opacity.

tokens.name: opacity-separator

motion.note: Motion keeps your place and answers the pointer; nothing in the reading column or the list moves on its own. Only color, opacity, a popup's small scale and a fold change; nothing slides. Fixed ease-out curves, no springs; closing takes no longer than opening; keyboard actions are immediate. Under reduced motion scale and folds are immediate, only fades of motion-fast or less remain, and the spinner keeps turning.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Small things: color and opacity of hover and press, every exit, the star turning on.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: Large things: a popup or sheet arriving, a folder opening in the pane, the reader replacing its entry.

tokens.name: motion-spin
tokens.usage: One turn of the spinner while fetching or extracting.

tokens.name: motion-pop
tokens.usage: The scale a popup opens from, with a fade, out of the control that opened it. Nothing slides.

audit.note: Contrast floors (WCAG 2 ratios): each ink strength keeps its own floor so the ladder stays a ladder (fg 10, prose 8.5, fg2 7, muted 4.5); meaning colors 4.5, star and warning 3 (icons); 2.6 for faint and pane-faint, which carry only what is never needed to read (disabled things, a placeholder's hint beside its label, the decoration of a rule). Grounds are stacks of tokens, each laid over the one before, with alphas rounded to a byte as MyGo draws them. Change any color, run the audit again.
